data.headline: Add 2 weeks stock and boost marketing 25% to grow profit
data.why: The plan lifts weekly profit by the figures above versus today. Extra stock covers the 5-week lead time so you never miss a retailer order. Marketing spend draws in German and Dutch buyers who are shifting to secondhand, letting you capture full-price sales before they browse used sites.
data.watch_out: If the US sawmill closures tighten hardwood supply, your timber cost could jump 7% and erase the marketing gain. The bad case is higher unit cost with no price room because rival Baltic Woodworks already sits $22 below you.
data.recheck_when: Check NHLA closure updates quarterly; re-evaluate if rival cuts price further.
